speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The day is not over because the morning was long. This is the evening prayer. I will not add a sermon to a passion.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Black this morning and black now. We are not dressing the parish up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am stood. I have nothing to add to it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The ledge is still bare. I looked, from habit.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Leave the ledge. The prayer is the prayer. You may go when I have done, and not with a branch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No branch. I am going home when you let us. The afternoon was quiet. I am keeping it quiet.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then keep it. I did not bring the house out a second time to hear a new matter.
